label: Outdoors
description: Outdoor settings: city streets, suburbs, farms, gardens, coasts, mountains, forests, deserts, waterways and ruins.
notes: Whole outdoor settings belong here, from ordinary streets and backyards to wild landscapes and imagined worlds. place.landform owns landform names in isolation; interior_space lists own enclosed rooms and cave interiors. Values are noun phrases naming a place with concrete, visible surroundings, ready to follow “the setting is.” Region and climate tags retain setting-specific constraints; era and genre tags are reserved for scenes that require a historical or imagined context.
